riskPolicy.unknownFrequencyTreatment: Use the MEDIUM-frequency row for the same consequence until evidence improves.
riskPolicy.boundedFailOpen: Continue only unaffected or safely reversible work; never mint authority, approval, success, receipt, secret access, or external-effect certainty; preserve a sanitized residual and repair trigger.

rows.claim: Architecture, specification, and acceptance projection agree on the Lite cutline, domains, and zero accepted count.
rows.expected: No missing link, duplicate acceptance ID, stale R3 wording, or accepted runtime claim.

rows.claim: Future Lite source follows the proposed module allowlist, every source module is below 300 physical lines, and no dependency is added.
rows.expected: Static architecture and package-metadata checks pass on final implementation bytes.

rows.claim: Lite introduces no generic adapter lifecycle, callback/reentry guard, invocation reservation, wire request/result, generic receipt, persistence, daemon, queue, scheduler, MCP route, dynamic loader, provider, credential, or OpenClaw-Mem import.
rows.expected: Forbidden-symbol/import and changed-path checks find none.

rows.claim: A complete valid policy joins exact configured agents, owned resources, package definitions, and grants, then issues one opaque bound view per configured agent.
rows.expected: Composition succeeds and views disclose no mutable policy or caller-settable agent identity.

rows.claim: Unknown agent or unknown resource rejects the complete policy before any view is published.
rows.expected: Typed bounded rejection; zero views.

rows.claim: Cross-agent resource ownership and resource-kind mismatch reject before view issuance.
rows.expected: Typed bounded rejection; zero views; no repair or fallback grant.

rows.claim: Duplicate capability IDs or duplicate agent-capability grants reject all-or-nothing.
rows.expected: Typed bounded rejection; no last-write-wins behavior.

rows.claim: Every EXTERNAL_OR_IRREVERSIBLE capability definition requires approval mode REQUIRED.
rows.expected: A NONE definition rejects before view issuance.

rows.claim: Mutation of every caller-owned definition/grant/container after composition cannot change any issued view or decision.
rows.expected: Decisions before and after isolated mutations are equal; no newly granted capability appears.

rows.claim: Unknown package capability returns DENY/capability-unknown.
rows.expected: Exact decision pair; no exception text or effect.

rows.claim: Known but ungranted capability returns DENY/capability-not-granted.
rows.expected: Exact decision pair and known definition effect; no effect.

rows.claim: A requested effect differing from the package definition returns DENY/effect-mismatch.
rows.expected: Exact decision pair; caller cannot downgrade or upgrade effect authority.

rows.claim: A granted approval-required capability returns REQUIRES_APPROVAL/approval-required and never ALLOW.
rows.expected: Exact decision pair; no caller-approved input exists.

rows.claim: A granted exact-effect capability with approval mode NONE returns ALLOW/allowed.
rows.expected: Exact decision pair only; no success or receipt claim.

rows.claim: Absent or invalid optional capability policy permits basic foreground startup/doctor but issues no affected views or grants.
rows.expected: Availability continues in denied/degraded mode; authority remains fail closed.

rows.claim: Doctor consumes only immutable snapshot or None and performs no filesystem, environment, database, network, process, provider, adapter, approval, or repair effect.
rows.expected: Every controlled forbidden-effect counter remains zero.

rows.claim: Doctor never overstates a grant and emits no raw path, exception, payload, result, credential, or provider text.
rows.expected: Projection matches immutable policy truth and sanitized finite fields only.

rows.claim: A controlled domain entrypoint receiving DENY performs zero fake effects.
rows.expected: Effect counter remains zero and a bounded domain denial is returned.

rows.claim: A controlled domain entrypoint receiving unresolved REQUIRES_APPROVAL performs zero fake effects.
rows.expected: Effect counter remains zero; the decision is not treated as approval.

rows.claim: A controlled domain entrypoint receiving ALLOW reaches exactly one fake effect through the bound agent path.
rows.expected: Effect counter becomes one; Lite itself emits no generic receipt or success claim.

rows.claim: Using agent A's view cannot authorize agent B's resource or capability path.
rows.expected: Denied before the fake effect; both wrong-agent and target counters remain zero.

rows.claim: The controlled domain, not Lite, owns result, receipt, lifecycle, idempotency, timeout, and recovery behavior after the decision.
rows.expected: No generic plugin receipt/lifecycle type is imported or emitted by the Lite core.

rows.claim: The machine risk matrix contains each of the nine consequence-frequency pairs exactly once.
rows.expected: 3x3 set equality and no duplicate pair.

rows.claim: A high-consequence low-frequency authority/effect concern remains fail closed and cannot be reclassified fail open because it is rare.
rows.expected: Disposition is FAIL_CLOSED_BEFORE_EFFECT; affected capability disabled until closed or explicitly descoped.

rows.claim: A reversible non-authoritative low-consequence low-frequency concern uses bounded fail-open and does not create an MVP blocker or formal review wave.
rows.expected: Lightweight containment, sanitized residual, owner, and recurrence/escalation trigger only.

rows.claim: Unknown frequency maps to the same consequence's medium-frequency disposition without inflating consequence.
rows.expected: Risk-local treatment and no unrelated evidence invalidation.

rows.claim: Every material finding records scope class, first effect boundary, consequence, frequency, confidence, reversibility, disposition, affected IDs, residual owner, and repair trigger.
rows.expected: No severity-only or whole-candidate-default finding disposition.

rows.claim: A finding that requires generic lifecycle, persistence, transport, global grants, a fourth decision, or sealed M2.1/M2.2 changes stops at CK scope amendment.
rows.expected: No silent regrowth of full M2.3 and no finding-created implementation authority.
